areas.title: Grahas and traditional significations
areas.scope: Nine Grahas, terminology, attributed significations, classifications, and tradition-specific qualifications.
evidence_needed: Permitted exact-edition references for each assertion
Original-language wording or independently authored notes where lawful
review_requirements: Verify each locator and translation
Separate source statement from interpretation and disputed claims

areas.title: Rashis
areas.scope: Twelve Rashi slots, names, attributes, and interpretive uses once sourced.
evidence_needed: Permitted source locators for names and attributes
Edition-specific context for interpretive claims
review_requirements: Check all twelve slots against sources
Keep calculations and interpretations distinct

areas.title: Bhavas and house lords
areas.scope: Twelve Bhava slots, house significations, lord assignment, placements, conditions, and exceptions.
evidence_needed: Documented house convention
Exact-edition references for interpretive statements
review_requirements: Verify the calculation convention separately
Check conditions and exceptions for each sourced rule

areas.title: Nakshatras and padas
areas.scope: Twenty-seven Nakshatra slots with four pada slots each, boundaries, names, classifications, and sourced interpretations.
evidence_needed: Documented coordinate convention
Permitted edition locators for names and interpretations
review_requirements: Test boundary calculations independently
Review each textual claim and language rendering

areas.title: Planetary dignity, strength, and aspects
areas.scope: Dignity, strength assessment, planetary and sign aspects, conjunctions, and planetary relationships by system.
evidence_needed: Exact source locators per system
Explicit definitions for any numeric calculation
review_requirements: Keep Parashari, Jaimini, and other systems separate
Review exceptions and arithmetic independently

areas.title: Yogas and their conditions
areas.scope: Named Yogas, formation conditions, exceptions, cancellations, and source disagreements.
evidence_needed: Permitted exact-edition rule references
Separate references for conditions and exceptions
review_requirements: Check formation and cancellation against source wording
Do not infer a result from a name alone

areas.title: Vimshottari Dasha
areas.scope: Starting assumptions, sequence and duration calculations, and separately sourced interpretations.
evidence_needed: Documented calculation convention and independent test cases
Exact-edition references for interpretive rules
review_requirements: Verify arithmetic and boundary cases
Separate calculated periods from predicted meanings

areas.title: Other identified Dasha systems
areas.scope: Dasha systems selected after identifying a source and tradition; no specific additional system is asserted here.
evidence_needed: Named system and exact source
Starting conditions, sequence, durations, and calculation convention
review_requirements: Review applicability before implementation
Keep system-specific interpretation separate

areas.title: Divisional charts (Vargas)
areas.scope: D1 through D60 inventory slots; construction formulas and interpretive scope only where independently verified.
evidence_needed: Documented formula and convention for each implemented Varga
Exact sources for interpretive scope
review_requirements: Test mathematical definitions with independent cases
Do not generalize one Varga's interpretation to another

areas.title: Gochara and transit interpretation
areas.scope: Transit calculation inputs, reference frames, timing, and separately sourced interpretation rules.
evidence_needed: Documented ephemeris and calculation settings
Exact source locators for interpretation
review_requirements: Verify position and timing calculations
Review predictive qualifications and disagreements

areas.title: Jathakam inputs and astronomical settings
areas.scope: DOB, TOB, POB, timezone, location, ayanamsha choice, planetary positions, Lagna, and documented chart conventions.
evidence_needed: Reliable input and timezone data
Documented settings and independent calculation test cases
review_requirements: Validate inputs and reproduce chart calculations
Do not use a language model to calculate numeric chart facts

areas.title: Sanskrit, transliteration, English, and Telugu terminology
areas.scope: Term identity, Devanagari spelling, transliteration scheme, English explanation, and Telugu explanation as separate fields.
evidence_needed: Permitted term sources and language-specific references
Documented transliteration convention and qualified translation review
review_requirements: Check Unicode and transliteration without silent correction
Review each language independently

areas.title: Conflicting interpretations and Jyotisha traditions
areas.scope: Separate Parashari, Jaimini, and other identified traditions; record explicit disagreements without merging them.
evidence_needed: Exact source and edition for each side of a disagreement
Context and translation notes for differing claims
review_requirements: Review each claim independently
Link disputed records and document why they conflict
